note: Geometry, kind and a per-feature source hash only. No source name, code or attribute is copied; the border layer ships the ring lines of the municipality configured for the station (selected by code in the overlay config; the station origin need not fall inside it), and that municipality's name and code are not copied; the geometry is clipped to a 700 m disc around the station frame origin and is not the full source line; feature_hash is the hash of the whole source feature. No feature of this source meets the window: no GeoJSON and no GLB are written for this run, and the layer counts record where each source feature left the selection.

window.selection_rule: A feature is selected when any segment of its projected polyline meets a closed disc of the window; selected features are then clipped to the clip disc (when one is configured), after projection; without a clip they are kept whole. The border layer first keeps only the municipality polygon whose code matches the station's ward (the code and property name are not copied); its rings are read as closed lines and no ring role or name is carried.
